title: GNN-SHM: Graph Neural Networks for H3 Rocket Fairing Structural Health Monitoring
description: JAXA H3 CFRP fairing debonding detection via FEM + PyTorch Geometric GNNs. Geometry-aware graph construction, multi-architecture training (GCN/GAT/GIN/SAGE), and H3-spec validation. Light sanity checks via scripts/reproduce_core.sh with CI-tested unit tests.
